historical_outer_artifacts: isolated; never used for this protocol or model selection
task: PADS PD=0 versus DD=1; 390 subjects, 5 outer folds each tested once

architecture.STR_change: shared Linear(258,16)+GELU on each of 11 bilateral activity tokens, ordered flatten 176D, Linear(176,2) residual logits added to V8-GN base logits; zero initialization of residual head

recipe.train_only_normalization: per activity/wrist/channel mean+std fitted on corresponding outer-train subjects, epsilon 1e-6
recipe.inner_early_stopping: validation balanced accuracy, patience 12, minimum delta 0, best checkpoint
recipe.outer_final_refit: all corresponding outer-train subjects; train-only normalization and class weights; no validation/test early stopping; fixed epochs = rounded-up median of three inner best one-based epochs; final checkpoint only

decision_rule.deep: per model/seed/outer fold DD probability >= threshold maximizing inner OOF BA; exact candidate/tie rules in frozen src/metrics/threshold.py; no outer threshold fitting
decision_rule.secondary_deep: default argmax/0.5 for descriptive matched development comparison only

H1_pipeline.features: frozen 4928D label-independent handcrafted matrix with fixed schema
H1_pipeline.fit: outer-train only median imputer -> zero-variance filter -> StandardScaler -> LogisticRegression(C=1,class_weight=None,solver=liblinear,max_iter=5000,random_state=42)
H1_pipeline.test: outer-test once after full train fit

metrics.primary_aggregation: per outer fold metric, average 3 deep seed metrics inside fold; then 5 outer folds as paired statistical units
metrics.confidence_interval: paired bootstrap resampling the 5 outer folds, 10000 replicates, fixed RNG seed 20260926; report wide intervals and no claim of independent seeds/subject pairs
metrics.pooled_390: descriptive only; each outer subject tested once per seed; no seed probability ensemble

comparison: STR-01 minus V8-GN and STR-01 minus H1 on matched five folds; development vs outer descriptive, with default-0.5 secondary to match development decision
prohibited: No outer-based model selection, hyperparameter/threshold/epoch/recipe change, diagnostic probes, fusion, correction, activity or mechanism search
